summary: Megacap earnings are the dominant force this week, with Alphabet and Tesla both reporting today amid a broad tech-led equity rally. Tesla's record Q2 deliveries, up 25% year-over-year and well above estimates, are reinforcing risk appetite even as long-term bonds stay under pressure from lingering Iran conflict inflation fears.
tweet: Alphabet and Tesla headlining today's earnings wave — Tesla's record Q2 deliveries are driving the risk-on tone even as bonds price in Iran-linked inflation risk.
